CustomField.description: Shows a divider on this section. Field Set sections draw it inside the form; every other section type draws it around the section, placed by Divider Position and styled by Divider Style, Title, Subtitle, Icon and Vertical Margin. Off by default.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Turn on to show a divider line for this section. Configure its look with the Divider Style, Title, Subtitle, Icon, Position, and Margin fields on the Divider tab.
CustomField.label: Show Divider
